mission.title: Hear Me
mission.description: Help Seraph search for Sati's signal in the code of the General's soldiers.

npc.say: I will return Neo to Zion...if it takes my very last breath.
We'll have to be ready to jump on this signal wherever we pick it up.

phase.briefing: Warrior, Seraph is ready to make another try at locating Sati. I'm sending you to meet him directly.

enter.say: Seraph's a cool guy and all, but I wonder when he's going to lose the "Aqueduct chic" look.

talk.say:
Our last attempt to locate Sati through the General's soldiers met with failure when I was unable to make use of the impressions of her signal embedded in their code. Enough time has passed that I believe it worth making another attempt. Even if we again find only faint impressions, they may be different enough to offer some clue.
As before, I will guide you to the commandos.

done.say:
Well hey, why not? Did we have anything better to do than following Seraph while he sniffs ex-Sentinel soldiers?
Anyway, I like that gold code signal he sends me. It's all warm and fuzzy.
Failure is only true failure if it causes us to lose hope.

objective.text: Lead Seraph out of the area

phase.briefing: I wish you luck, {player}. Seraph's unflagging confidence is an inspiration.

enter.say: The gold code says that's the spot where the action goes down. I still can't see those Elite Commandos, so I'll just be here imagining you kicking butt.

objective.text: Kill all of the Elite Commandos

done.say: Check with Seraph, and see if this finally got us anywhere.

talk.say:
Yes... I think there is a slight difference this time. It-- Eh?
There's something else--something I've sought for a long time, and felt in brief flashes of late. It's nearby. We must hurry before it vanishes.

done.say:
Now what the dickens could he be talking about?
Hold up; Tyndall's buzzing my ear off. You'd better make with the foot motions.

phase.briefing: Warrior, wide area sensors have detected Nabonidus beacon signal activity somewhere in your area. We've never been able to get a clear reading of the signal's pattern, so we can't determine the exact position, but it sounds like Seraph has picked up on it as well. Follow him. We have to find out if this signal really is coming from Morpheus.

enter.say:
Nabonidus? Morpheus?!
Okay... Stay calm... Remember training... The gold code was pointing in there. I've got Seraph on my screen, and something...else.
Is that... Is it him? Talk to it or something!

talk.say: How can we truly be free...until the One who saved us is returned?

done.say: That's it, {player}! We've finally got a clear reading of the signal. We should be able to pinpoint it quickly whenever it reappears in the Matrix. Has Seraph reacted to it?

talk.say: It is the image of Morpheus...sent...from a distance. But from where?

done.say: I'm sending you to report this directly to Ghost, {player}. We'll take up tracking Sati again once this has been handled.
I must tell the Oracle of this.

phase.briefing: This is the closest we've come to establishing real contact with the signal, {player}. I think this is the breakthrough we've been waiting for.

enter.say:
Morpheus... Man... Morpheus...
Excuse me, I'm having a little moment here.

talk.say:
Hm... If this really is Morpheus, he's picked a hell of a time to bring himself back from the dead. And still not giving us any real information, either--unless the signal itself is the information. Now that we've got the signal pattern, we'll be able to find it wherever and whenever it appears. I wonder if that's the idea--to lead us somewhere.
Well, we'll find out, huh? Good work, {player}. Looks like we're finally getting somewhere with this.

mission.finish:
Remember that we're still reliant on the Truce to keep Zion from being obliterated by the Machines. It's already under considerable strain due to Machine demands, and their underhanded use of the Cypherites to impair our recruiting efforts. We can't forget that Morpheus' last recorded actions several years ago nearly caused the Truce to fail...
{player}, whatever happens, we must ensure that the last free city survives.
